states: Production vite build of this tree served by vite preview and proxied to the pulse-dev :7699 perf rig (token-required auth); Chromium headless, desktop 1280x800 and touch-phone 390x844.

Before a token exists the Linux path offers only Generate token. After generation all ten Unix install commands on the page (Linux, private-token-file, macOS and the other Unix families) read 'then if ! sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then sudo -v; fi;' and none use a bare 'sudo -v'; the two remaining code fragments are the literal word sudo in guidance.

Token reveal dialog unchanged; after Escape the Install on Linux and private-file commands render in their code blocks with the copy control. No page horizontal overflow and no page errors at either width.

Shell behaviour on the same Ubuntu 24.04 cloud-init host (NOPASSWD user, no password): the old preflight prints 'sudo: a password is required'; the new one passes without a prompt because the silent 'sudo -n true' succeeds, leaving 'sudo -v' only for hosts that need a password.
The synthetic install tokens minted on the rig during the runs were revoked afterwards (DELETE 204 each) and the preview server stopped.
interactions: Sign in, open Settings > Infrastructure, Add infrastructure, Install Pulse Agent.
Generate token, dismiss the reveal with Escape, scroll to the Install on Linux command and read every visible code block.
